title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4,…
description: An unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability exists in the reload task of the Visforms Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. This occurs because input placeholders in SQL field statements are inserted without proper quoting, allowing attackers to inject SQL commands in read queries.
